purpose: Public-source recheck of the four next-step measured-data actions after PR #103. This ledger is fail-closed: metadata, machine-family conventions, sensor model capabilities and inferred units never increase accepted counts.

actions.result: four already-promoted discoveries removed from the active queue; AD-STGN remains the only active discovery
actions.governanceBoundary: queue membership is workflow state, not measured-data acceptance

publicChecks.finding: publisher still describes upper injection-moulding measurements as pressure target/actual, velocity, volume and state, and ~1 kHz sampling, without an engineering unit for pressure or a state-code mapping

current author loader still reads injection_pressure_target, injection_pressure_actual, melt_volume, injection_velocity and state directly from CSV and applies no source-defined pressure-unit or state semantic conversion
public repository issue search located no source-author answer defining injection_pressure_actual units or state codes

actions.decision: keep injection_pressure_actual non-counting; keep pressure target and state non-counting; retain prepared source-author clarification text unsent

publicChecks.finding: live dataset record continues to expose cycle CSVs and stage files but provides no field-level unit/scaling dictionary for the unresolved columns

instrumentation paper identifies Kistler 4262A hydraulic-pressure, P510 screw-position, 4021B nozzle-temperature and 6188A cavity pressure/temperature sensors plus ComoNeo acquisition, but does not bind delivered CSV numeric fields to engineering units/scales

later ML paper confirms hydraulic pressure, screw position, nozzle temperature and heating-water temperature were collected in CSV form, but does not define the delivered HydPressure/ScrewPosition units, position origin, or Analog Input[1]/[2] sensor-to-stage mappings

actions.decision: retain the four unresolved columns fail-closed; retain prepared source-author clarification text unsent

publicChecks.finding: live page still reports the real industrial injection-moulding case, CC BY 4.0, 66 continuous sensors, 7 control actions, 88,000 training samples and 22,614 validation samples; a Download All control is rendered but the Files section exposes no public file entries

actions.decision: keep all reported channel/sample counts metadata-only until publisher payload files are exposed and profiled
